info.title: qEvent Event Service
info.description: Events, rooms, sessions, ticket types and atomic seat reservations. The service owns `qevent_event` and never joins another service database. Organizer endpoints trust the `x-user-role` header forwarded by the API Gateway after JWT verification. Errors use `{ code, message }` except request validation failures, which return the Elysia validation payload.

post.summary: Atomically hold seats for an order
post.description: Used by the Admission Service saga. The operation is idempotent per `operationId`: replaying the same payload returns the stored reservation, while a different payload returns `409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`. Capacity is enforced with conditional updates on the event and ticket type inside one transaction, so concurrent callers cannot oversell.

200.description: Existing reservation replayed for the same operationId.

404.description: The ticket type does not exist.

409.description: Capacity is exhausted or the operationId conflicts with another payload.

value.message: Ticket type or event capacity is exhausted
